findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed wet mop head stored head down in mop bucket. Store wet mop heads in inverted fashion to promote drying. 

6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.comment:
Observed that the cold water faucet had hot water flowing from it at all sinks in the kitchen. This occurred when we were running the dish machine. Apparently this has happened on more than one occasion in the ten years this school has been in operation. I am concerned that this could be a back flow issue. I am not a plumber and therefore did not write it up as a plumbing violation. District OAM has been notified along with Cheryl McBride. The issue will be repaired as soon as possible.  District OAM is on site (a plumber with 25 yrs experience) He believes a cross connection is the issue and is working to correct the situation. 
5-205.15: A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW; P and (B) Maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment: Observed an area of caulk at the try return and garbage disposal/spray area to be soiled with mold. The silicone seal is not longer smooth and easily cleanable. Remove silicone seal, clean wall and replace seal. 6-201.16: (A) Wall and ceiling covering materials shall be attached so that they are EASILY CLEANABLE. (B) Except in areas used only for dry storage, concrete, porous blocks, or bricks used for indoor wall construction shall be finished and SEALED to provide a SMOOTH, nonabsorbent, EASILY CLEANABLE surface.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment: Foods are placed out on the serving counter for the volunteers. Some of these foods are potentially hazardous and require refrigeration during service and display. The foods were not labeled with the time. 750-153(a) When using time as a control. Food shall be marked to indicate the time when it was removed from a temperature controlled environment and used or discarded in within 4 hours. Properly label food when utilizing time as a control. Foods can not be placed back into mechanical refrigeration once the foods have been placed on the service counter with no active cold holding procedure. Foods were discarded and time tags will be utilized in the future.

findings.title: Sanitizing temperature
findings.comment: Observed the dish machine to be running with a low temperature on the wash cycle and with some variation on the rinse cycle.  A temperature tag run in the machine did not test properly which indicates that food contact surfaces are not being properly sanitized. Test the machine (run a tag) a minimum of once daily and watch temperature gages when using the machine. Have machine serviced so that it works properly before school resumes in August. 750-830 All hot water for sanitizing dishes and equipment must be a minimum of 180F when it leaves the dish washing machine manifold in order to kill pathogens.  Properly sanitize all items. Check and maintain the dishwasher frequently. They will discontunue use of machine for sanitizing until it can be repaired. Use 3 part sink for sanitizing.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: Observed the fan in the dish room to be soiled with dust and dirt. Clean and maintain clean or discontinue use as use of a soiled fan blows dirt around and onto the surfaces of cleaned food service contact items. 750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use and any time it may have become contaminated.

findings.title: Wholesome, sound condition
findings.comment: Observed 3 dented cans. Two of the cans had dents on seams (top edges) 750-100 Food shall be in sound condition, free from spoilage, filth, and other contamination and shall be safe for human consumption. Cans were pulled to be returned.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: Wall behind the sprayer/disposal is holding water and has some soil/mold growth. Repair/replace silicone so that it does not hold water. 750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.citation_text:
750.810 - Sanitizer solution was less than 200ppm quat. Solution was made earlier this morning and was used several times since being made. Solution was remade to be at proper concentration of 200ppm.

Maintain quat solution at 200ppm, and change solutions every 2 to 4 hours or more frequently if solution and wiping cloths become heavily soiled. The concentration will decrease over time just sitting at ambient temperature, but frequent use will increase the rate at which the concentration wears down. Use test strips to check solutions and verify proper sanitizing concentration is maintained.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.citation_text: 750.810 - Wiping cloth from sanitizer bucket used on general surfaces was used to wipe a stem thermometer. Separate solutions of sanitizer solution must be maintained for food contact surfaces and non-food contact surfaces. Manager setup a separate sanitizer solution for the stem thermometers.

findings.title: Lighting provided as required.  Fixtures shielded
findings.citation_text:
750.1230 - Light in walkin cooler was out. No light was available unless a flashlight was used and/or the door was left open. 
A work order will be placed. 

Permanently fixed artificial light sources shall be installed to provide at least 10 foot-candles of light in walkin refrigeration units and dry storage areas..

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.citation_text: 750.690 - A) Milk cooler had frost/ice buildup inside on walls. De-frost the milk cooler. B) Blue tape was observed on the handle of one metal cart. Remove tape and make proper repairs or replace the cart (tape is not an approved repair material. C) Paint is chipping off of dry storage shelves in some areas. Re-paint the shelves (if going to be kept for new kitchen) or replace. D) Serving counters with lower storage areas have chipping paint and areas of disrepair (gaps/cracks). Paint and make necessary repairs (if going to be kept for new kitchen) or replace. Non-food contact surfaces shall be smooth, cleanable, and of such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text:
750.1200 & 1220 - A) Glue trap full of bugs was observed on the floor between the back wall and shelving in the dry storage room. Most of the bugs were dead, but a few live roaches were stuck in there as well. Glue traps need to be switched out frequently to ensure effectiveness of pest control. (see general comments for details).
B) Loose baseboard was observed at the floor to wall juncture in the cafeteria (below Nutrition Facts Label and Enos Eagles Eatery signs/behind milk cooler). Area behind baseboard was soiled with buildup of debris. Clean behind the baseboard and re-seal baseboard to the wall.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e - The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled: A) tall floor fan in kitchen (dust buildup - not in use at time of inspection); B) hood filters (dust); & C) base of metal pan rack (dried food splash). Clean non-food contact surfaces daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1220 - Floors under dry storage shelves had some buildup of dust, debris, and dead bugs (some appeared to be roaches). An old glue trap full of dead bugs & debris was observed in the far back corner of the large storage room. Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors in the storage rooms daily/as needed, and change out glue traps as they accumulate insects and debris.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed the pan rack on the wooden prep table to be chipping paint. Seal or paint the rack.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.
